name: FastAPI
description: Monitor FastAPI web applications with OpenTelemetry automatic ASGI instrumentation and Uptrace exporter.

steps.title: Install OpenTelemetry and Uptrace packages
steps.description: Install the Uptrace Python distro alongside the FastAPI and ASGI OpenTelemetry instrumentors using pip:
steps.content: pip install uptrace opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi opentelemetry-instrumentation-asgi uvicorn

steps.title: Configure environment variables
steps.description: Set the Uptrace DSN and OpenTelemetry service identifier in your environment or .env file:

variables.name: UPTRACE_DSN
variables.description: Your project DSN from Uptrace Project Settings

variables.description: Logical service name displayed in Uptrace dashboard

steps.title: Instrument your FastAPI application
steps.description: Initialize Uptrace OpenTelemetry and instrument the FastAPI app instance before starting the server:
steps.content:
import os
from fastapi import FastAPI
import uptrace
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.fastapi import FastAPIInstrumentor

app = FastAPI(title="My Instrumented API")

# Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace
uptrace.configure_opentelemetry(
    dsn=os.getenv("UPTRACE_DSN"),
    service_name=os.getenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "fastapi-backend"),
    service_version="1.0.0",
)

# Instrument FastAPI application instance
FastAPIInstrumentor.instrument_app(app)

@app.get("/api/hello")
def hello_world():
    return {"status": "ok", "message": "OpenTelemetry telemetry active"}

steps.title: Start the application
steps.description: Run your FastAPI application using Uvicorn:
steps.content: uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

steps.title: Verify telemetry in Uptrace
steps.description: Send a sample HTTP request and verify incoming telemetry in Uptrace:
steps.content:
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/hello

Then open Uptrace -> Traces / Services to verify spans and requests are visible.

steps.description: Add Uptrace configuration and DjangoInstrumentor in your manage.py or wsgi.py entrypoint:
steps.content:
import os
import sys
import uptrace
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.django import DjangoInstrumentor

def main():
    os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'myproject.settings')
    
    # Configure Uptrace OpenTelemetry
    uptrace.configure_opentelemetry(
        dsn=os.getenv("UPTRACE_DSN"),
        service_name=os.getenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "django-service"),
        service_version="1.0.0",
    )
    DjangoInstrumentor().instrument()
    
    from django.core.management import execute_from_command_line
    execute_from_command_line(sys.argv)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

name: Python
description: Configure OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics in any Python service, worker, or script with Uptrace.

steps.title: Configure Uptrace in Python code
steps.description: Initialize tracer provider and create manual spans:
steps.content:
import uptrace
from opentelemetry import trace

# Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace
uptrace.configure_opentelemetry(
    dsn="https://<token>@uptrace.dev/<project_id>",
    service_name="python-worker",
    service_version="1.0.0",
)

tracer = trace.get_tracer("worker-tracer")

with tracer.start_as_current_span("process-job") as span:
    span.set_attribute("job.id", 1042)
    span.set_attribute("job.status", "completed")
    print("Processing job complete.")

name: Go
description: Monitor Go applications with official uptrace-go OpenTelemetry distribution, tracing, and metrics.

steps.title: Initialize Uptrace in main.go
steps.description: Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace in your Go entrypoint:
steps.content:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/uptrace/uptrace-go/uptrace"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace
	uptrace.ConfigureOpentelemetry(
		uptrace.WithDSN(os.Getenv("UPTRACE_DSN")),
		uptrace.WithServiceName("go-backend"),
		uptrace.WithServiceVersion("1.0.0"),
	)
	defer uptrace.Shutdown(ctx)

	tracer := otel.Tracer("app-tracer")
	ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "main-operation")
	defer span.End()

	fmt.Println("Uptrace OpenTelemetry initialized successfully.")
}

steps.description: Export environment variable and run the application:

go run main.go

name: Kubernetes
description: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet on Kubernetes to collect pod metrics, container logs, and cluster telemetry for Uptrace.

steps.title: Create Kubernetes Secret for Uptrace DSN
steps.description: Store your Uptrace DSN securely in a Kubernetes Secret:
steps.content:
kubectl create namespace uptrace
kubectl create secret generic uptrace-dsn \
  --namespace uptrace \
  --from-literal=UPTRACE_DSN='https://<token>@uptrace.dev/<project_id>'

steps.title: Create OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet Manifest
steps.description: Save the following configuration as otel-collector-k8s.yaml:
steps.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: otel-collector-config
  namespace: uptrace
data:
  otel-collector-config.yaml: |
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
          http:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
      k8s_cluster:
        collection_interval: 30s
      kubeletstats:
        collection_interval: 20s
        auth_type: "serviceAccount"
        endpoint: "https://${env:K8S_NODE_NAME}:10250"
        insecure_skip_verify: true

    processors:
      batch:
        timeout: 5s
        send_batch_size: 1024
      memory_limiter:
        check_interval: 1s
        limit_percentage: 75
        spike_limit_percentage: 20
      k8sattributes:
        auth_type: "serviceAccount"
        passthrough: false
        extract:
          metadata:
            - k8s.pod.name
            - k8s.namespace.name
            - k8s.node.name
            - k8s.deployment.name

    exporters:
      otlp/uptrace:
        endpoint: otlp.uptrace.dev:4317
        tls:
          insecure: false
        headers:
          uptrace-dsn: ${env:UPTRACE_DSN}

    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, batch]
          exporters: [otlp/uptrace]
        metrics:
          receivers: [otlp, k8s_cluster, kubeletstats]
          processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, batch]
          exporters: [otlp/uptrace]

steps.title: Apply Manifest to Kubernetes Cluster
steps.description: Apply the ConfigMap and Collector DaemonSet:
steps.content:
kubectl apply -f otel-collector-k8s.yaml
kubectl get pods -n uptrace

steps.title: Verify Cluster Telemetry
steps.description: Open Uptrace -> Infrastructure -> Kubernetes to verify nodes, pods, and container metrics.
steps.content: kubectl logs -n uptrace -l app=opentelemetry-collector --tail=50

sudo dpkg -i otelcol-contrib_*_linux_amd64.deb

steps.title: Configure hostmetrics receiver in config.yaml
steps.description: Create the hostmetrics configuration pipeline:
steps.content:
receivers:
  hostmetrics:
    collection_interval: 10s
    scrapers:
      cpu:
      memory:
      load:
      disk:
      filesystem:
      network:
      processes:

processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 512
  resourcedetection:
    detectors: [system, env]
    timeout: 2s

exporters:
  otlp/uptrace:
    endpoint: otlp.uptrace.dev:4317
    headers:
      uptrace-dsn: ${env:UPTRACE_DSN}

service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      receivers: [hostmetrics]
      processors: [resourcedetection, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/uptrace]
